title: Intrepid
wikitext:
'''''Intrepid''''' is one of the [[frigate]]s that belonged to the [[Lost Fleet|Third Fleet]] of [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiras]]. It was destroyed by the [[Dragonmaw clan]] during the [[Second War]] and now lies as part of the [[Lost Fleet]] in [[Baradin Bay]] at the northwestern edge of the [[Wetlands]], just north of another sunken boat, the ''[[Wave Mistress]]''.
